newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyundai Heavy aims to earn $9 bln orders.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai Heavy aims to earn $9 bln orders.

text.p: Hyundai Heavy Industries Co Ltd, a unit of South Korea's Hyundai Group, said on Wednesday it aimed to receive orders worth $9 billion in 1997, up from $6.8 billion in 1996.
The company said in a statement it set its sales target for this year at 5.4 trillion won, against 4.7 trillion in 1996.
Hyundai Heavy is the nation's largest shipbuilder. It also makes industrial plants and heavy industrial equipment.
It said shipbuilding orders would reach $3.4 billion in 1997, compared with $2.24 billion in 1996.
Target for industrial plant orders was set at $1.7 billion this year, against $1.54 billion in 1996.
The company said it has set its total export target at $3.6 billion in 1997, up 10.3 percent from 1996.
